description_en: Performs asynchronous operations on a service
description_zh: 异步执行产品操作功能
kebab_example: aliyun bpstudio execute-operation-async --service-type ecs --operation addTags --api-version 2021-09-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExecuteOperationASync

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Architect Design Tools application
parameters.name: application_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. To modify ECS-related parameters, set this parameter to ecs
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型，如果需要修改ecs的相关参数请填写：ecs
parameters.name: service_type

parameters.help_en:
The operation type to perform on the service. Some operation types are general, and others are dedicated.

The following examples show ECS-related operations:
Rename an ECS instance: rename
Change instance type: modifyInstanceType
Start an ECS instance: modifyInstanceType
Stop an ECS instance: modifyInstanceType
Restart an ECS instance: modifyInstanceType
Add tags to an ECS instance: addTags
Delete an ECS instance: ecsDelete
Change the billing method of an ECS instance: modifyPayType
parameters.help_zh:
本次操作类型，是修改产品的操作类型，有的操作类型是通用，有的是单独使用。
下面为ecs的相关编配示例：
ecs的名称：rename
ecs的规格：modifyInstanceType
ecs的启动：modifyInstanceType
ecs的停止：modifyInstanceType
ecs的重启：modifyInstanceType
ecs添加标签：addTags
ecs的删除：ecsDelete
ecs的付费类型：modifyPayType
parameters.name: operation

parameters.help_en:
The operation parameters. Specify the parameters based on the Operation value. The value is passed as a map.

The following examples show ECS configuration changes:
Common parameters required for ECS:
change_type,
regionId,
instanceId,
appId
Example for changing the ECS instance type:
{
"ServiceType": "ecs",
"Operation": "modifyInstanceType",
"Attributes": "{\"change_type\":\"modify_instance_type\",\"instance_type\":\"ecs.hfr7.2xlarge\",\"instanceId\":\"i-xxxxxxxxx\",\"regionId\":\"ap-southeast-1\",\"appId\":\"xxxxxxxxxxxxx\"}"
}
Example for stopping an ECS instance:
{
"ServiceType": "ecs",
"Operation": "modifyInstanceType",
"Attributes": "{\"change_type\":\"modify_status\",\"status\":\"Stopped\",\"instanceId\":\"i-xxxxxxxxx\",\"regionId\":\"ap-southeast-1\",\"appId\":\"xxxxxxxxxxxxx\"}"
}
Example for starting an ECS instance:
{
"ServiceType": "ecs",
"Operation": "modifyInstanceType",
"Attributes": "{\"change_type\":\"modify_status\",\"status\":\"Running\",\"instanceId\":\"i-xxxxxxxxx\",\"regionId\":\"ap-southeast-1\",\"appId\":\"xxxxxxxxxxxxx\"}"
}
Example for restarting an ECS instance:
{
"ServiceType": "ecs",
"Operation": "modifyInstanceType",
"Attributes": "{\"change_type\":\"modify_status\",\"status\":\"Restart\",\"instanceId\":\"i-xxxxxxxxx\",\"regionId\":\"ap-southeast-1\",\"appId\":\"xxxxxxxxxxxxx\"}"
}
parameters.help_zh:
操作相关参数，根据不同的Operation值，输入对应的参数，此次传值是以map的形式传参。
以下为ecs的变配为例：
ecs的需要传递的公共参数如下：
change_type,
regionId,
instanceId,
appId
ecs变更规格的参数值示例：
{
"ServiceType": "ecs",
"Operation": "modifyInstanceType",
"Attributes": "{\"change_type\":\"modify_instance_type\",\"instance_type\":\"ecs.hfr7.2xlarge\",\"instanceId\":\"i-xxxxxxxxx\",\"regionId\":\"cn-beijing\",\"appId\":\"xxxxxxxxxxxxx\"}"
}
ecs停止实例如下：
{
"ServiceType": "ecs",
"Operation": "modifyInstanceType",
"Attributes": "{\"change_type\":\"modify_status\",\"status\":\"Stopped\",\"instanceId\":\"i-xxxxxxxxx\",\"regionId\":\"cn-beijing\",\"appId\":\"xxxxxxxxxxxxx\"}"
}
ecs启动的参数实例如下：
{
"ServiceType": "ecs",
"Operation": "modifyInstanceType",
"Attributes": "{\"change_type\":\"modify_status\",\"status\":\"Running\",\"instanceId\":\"i-xxxxxxxxx\",\"regionId\":\"cn-beijing\",\"appId\":\"xxxxxxxxxxxxx\"}"
}
ecs重启的实例如下：
{
"ServiceType": "ecs",
"Operation": "modifyInstanceType",
"Attributes": "{\"change_type\":\"modify_status\",\"status\":\"Restart\",\"instanceId\":\"i-xxxxxxxxx\",\"regionId\":\"cn-beijing\",\"appId\":\"xxxxxxxxxxxxx\"}"
}
